component.name: Videos
component.summary: Watch your films with a controller

description.p: Videos is a film browser and player drawn in the LineXinBar design language: the same colours, glass, motion and marks as the shell it was made for, and driven from a controller, a keyboard and a pointer at once.

A folder is a wall of films, each card wearing a frame out of the film itself and how long it runs. Those frames are written to the same thumbnail cache every other program on the machine shares, so a folder browsed here is a folder with pictures on it everywhere else too.

Playing one fills the screen with the film. The controls come up when anything is pressed and go away four seconds later, and the film grows to take the whole screen when they do — nothing is ever drawn over the picture except its subtitles. Left and right move through the film, ten seconds a press and further while held; the triggers scan through it; up and down are the volume.

Where you left off is remembered and offered again the next time that film is opened, and a film watched to its end is forgotten rather than remembered at its credits. Subtitles come from inside the film or from a file beside it, and one the film marks as forced — or one somebody put there themselves — is shown without being asked for.
Films decode through this machine's video hardware where it has any, and in software where it does not.
It is an ordinary Wayland application and runs on any desktop.
The first release. A folder of films, and one film at a time.
This release shares its version with LineXinBar, lxb-toolkit, Imagonsole, DistriBumpy and CEDM.
